multipliers.method: 85th / 90th / 95th / 99th percentile of |move / k sigma| over the last 250 matured daily forecasts

calibration.method: k = RMS(move / raw sigma) over the last 250 matured daily forecasts

fan.method: analytic bands from k sigma x hour-of-day profile; paths are normal draws

model.spec: HAR-RV: log RV of the next 23 hours on log RV of the last 1 / 5 / 22 days
